questions.text:
Analyse how time was manipulated for a particular purpose.

Write an essay on at least ONE visual or oral text that you have studied, in response to this question. Support the points you make with specific details from the text(s). You should aim to write a concise essay of no more than 4-5 pages.
questions.markingGuide: Achievement (3-4): Present a structured response using essay conventions and analysis-related terminology appropriately. Address the question by exploring how time is manipulated (e.g. flashbacks, slow motion, montage, non-linear narrative) for a particular purpose. Show awareness that effects and meanings have been deliberately crafted. Include specific and relevant details from the text(s). Merit (5-6): Convincingly address the question, presenting a reasoned discussion showing clear understanding of how manipulation of time serves the director's/creator's purpose. Show awareness of deliberate crafting for a particular purpose. Weave a range of specific details. Excellence (7-8): Develop an insightful or original argument about how time manipulation creates meaning and serves the text's purpose, making judgments about how effects and meanings relate to wider contexts.
